args: $codexHome = if ($env:CODEX_HOME) { $env:CODEX_HOME } else { Join-Path $HOME '.codex' }; $pointerPath = Join-Path $codexHome 'codex-system.json'; $pointer = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($pointerPath, [Text.Encoding]::UTF8) | ConvertFrom-Json; $pluginRoot = if ($env:PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:PLUGIN_ROOT } elseif ($env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT } else { Join-Path $pointer.runtime_root 'plugins\codex-system' }; & $pointer.node_path (Join-Path $pluginRoot 'server.mjs'); exit $LASTEXITCODE
